name: Lethal Pursuit lets Shadow Rage stack 4 additional times (#1274)
contract: Lethal Pursuit 572530 has E0 aura 107 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER) MiscValue 31 (SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS, the Ascension operation declared in SpellDefines.h), BasePoints 3 / DieSides 1 = +4, class mask (0, 0x1000, 0); its description reads 'Shadow Rage now stacks $s1 additional times'. Both Shadow Rage records 804192 and 680275 have StackAmount 1 and SpellFamilyFlags B 0x1000, and SpellInfo::CalcMaxAuraStacks applies the modifier to the DBC stack amount: 1 + 4 = 5. Heartseeking Bolt 805754 has no stack amount and is the control (a modifier must not make a non-stacking aura stackable).

steps.label: The other Shadow Rage record stacks 4 additional times
A spell that cannot stack still cannot
Shadow Rage returns to one stack
